card.name: The word cream after a drug name
card.fires_on: The word cream (or Cream) when it follows a topical drug name such as imiquimod, pimecrolimus or mupirocin, or refers back to that product, in label text.

modes.label: Cream after drug name
modes.description: Capitalized or lowercase cream right after a generic drug name, naming the product.
modes.example: topical calcineurin inhibitors, including Pimecrolimus<< Cream>>, 1%, in any age group

modes.label: Cream as a back-reference
modes.description: The word cream after "The" in an instruction sentence, referring to the product just described.
